summary: Executed offline Node.js test suites for /app/ebid SAP E-Bidding bot. Both test-engine.js (20/20) and test-submit.js (11/11) passed with exit code 0. All three targeted bug fixes verified: (1) 'Same amount' and 'Same Avg amount' tie messages treated as SAVED without resubmit; (2) 'Reduce your bid by minimum Rs 2' is TERMINAL and added to failedKeys (no infinite retry loop); (3) 'Captcha Validation Failed. Worng Captcha Value' retries up to CAPTCHA_MAX_RETRY (3) then gives up, while 'Contact Administrator' triggers hard-lock backoff with a single submit. Sequential captcha ordering (fetch1→submit1→fetch2→submit2) confirmed. No live SAP network calls attempted.
seed_data_creation: None — mock SAP client embedded in test-submit.js.
